svg.title: Use the separated two-point configuration x = (e0, 0), with one exterior field O. At the scaled configuration sx, pull both labels through Ps. Define Es as the first-point divergence of the moment with the stress label PsT 0; define Bs as the same divergence with Ps(δO). Thus Bs is just the time derivative in the first position of the two-scalar moment. These derivatives are with respect to the unscaled configuration x, so the chain rule supplies a factor s multiplying the physical differentiated field. For a smooth shell cutoffχ around the first point, define Rs as the corresponding translation shell-flux test with stress PsT 0, inserted field PsO and exterior field PsO; define Qs with stress Ps(δO) in its place.
